step-1.text: If your poles come in pieces, screw them together by hand first. Then thread a wheel into the bottom of each pole. The two locking wheels go on the same side.

count-1.text: This step uses 4 poles and 4 caster wheels.

step-2.text: Pick your shelf heights, then clip a split plastic sleeve onto the same groove on every pole, thin end pointing up. Count from the bottom so each shelf sits level.

step-3.text: Stand the poles upright and slide the bottom shelf down over all four at once, until its corner collars rest on the sleeves. A helper keeps the poles straight.

step-4.text: Now the top shelf, the same way. With the top and bottom on, it stands on its own.

step-5.text: Slide the other two shelves down from the top onto their sleeves.

step-6.text: Tap each shelf corner down with a rubber mallet or the heel of your hand, so the collars lock onto the sleeves. Check it does not rock, then lock the two braking wheels.

count-6.text: Nothing new this step. Just you and the frame.

done.text: Done. Your UltraDurable 4-tier steel tote shelving is built. Give it a proud little pat.
